meaning: Execution-only feedback: the Fixer sees runtime success/failure, exception type, and traceback. Numerical and gradient/update defects that execute normally do not trigger repair.
description: Execution result, exception type, and traceback only.

meaning: Strict aggregate binary feedback: the verifier checks execution, numerical, and gradient/update signals, then exposes only one overall pass/fail bit to the Fixer. It exposes no failing stage, metric, step, tensor, parameter, or repair route.
description: One strict pass/fail bit without a stage label or metrics.

meaning: Stage-label feedback: the verifier checks all three layers and exposes only the first failing stage label, without numerical or tensor/parameter details.
description: First failing stage label without numeric or parameter diagnostics.

meaning: Flat full feedback: execution, numerical, and gradient/update evidence is exposed as an unordered metric collection, without first-failure localization or routing.
description: All E/N/G/U metrics without ordering, first-failure localization, or repair routing.

meaning: Hierarchical LADDER feedback: full evidence is ordered execution -> numerical -> gradient/update with first-failure localization and repair routing.
description: Full hierarchical E/N/G/U diagnosis with first-failure localization and repair routing.

meaning: Reverse hierarchical feedback: the same full evidence and routing as r_hier is presented gradient/update -> numerical -> execution.
description: Full diagnostics reported in gradient/update, numerical, execution order.
